title: Goldman says Japan's $1 trillion of reserves leaves 'plenty of capacity' for further yen interventions
summary_full: Japan has enough cash at its disposal for a couple more rounds of yen-buying on the scale of last month's intervention, Goldman Sachs says.
summary_public: Japan has enough cash at its disposal for a couple more rounds of yen-buying on the scale of last month's intervention, Goldman Sachs says.
